stages.headline: Monomials in standard form that differ only in their coefficients (or not at all) are like monomials.
stages.headlineEnglish: Monomials in standard form that differ only in their coefficients (or not at all) are like monomials.

stages.headline: To add like monomials, add the coefficients and keep the letter part; this is collecting like terms.
stages.headlineEnglish: To add like monomials, add the coefficients and keep the letter part; this is collecting like terms.

stages.headline: The sum of like monomials is a monomial; unlike ones cannot be combined: 2a + 3b stays as it is.
stages.headlineEnglish: The sum of like monomials is a monomial; unlike ones cannot be combined: 2a + 3b stays as it is.
